newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain employers say labour talks advancing slowly.
newsitem.headline: Spain employers say labour talks advancing slowly.

text.p: Spanish employers' association CEOE said on Tuesday that talks over labour reforms were advancing slowly, but unions appeared to be softening their stance.
"The talks are going very slowly, but they are advancing," CEOE president Jose Maria Cuevas told reporters after a break in talks for lunch.
Although Cuevas would not comment on an imminent deal he said "the unions have begun to move on some of the more rigid positions they have maintained during the talks."
Cuevas said his side would make the utmost effort to close a deal. He said it could be on Wednesday.
In any case, he said this was the last opportunity to secure labour market reforms.
The government has said that it will intervene and force an accord if the two sides cannot reach an agreement voluntarily.
